race.comment: RAVEN'S SILVER (2) narrowly on top. He won dominantly here first up before a solid effort as the $1.95 favourite last time, beaten a head in a very similar race. Bigger price now and doubt this takes any more winning, go close. KENTAHTEN (7) made nice improvement second up to win well at Hamilton over 1100m. Up in grade slightly but  has come back well and is worth keeping safe at a big price. RAGING MONKEY (12) doesn't win out of turn was close up latest and will roll forward on the quick backup. Can give a sight. CHICAGO BLUES (3) will find this easier than two runs back when well beaten. Very heavy a query but will kick up and take catching.
